Explicit development execution contract:

Stop/loss of Permit takes priority over Start. One scan is one invocation; retained state persists across scans of a case. Each case starts from a new instance. Independently of Reset, OverLimit is TRUE exactly when Valid AND (Value > 3252); when Valid is FALSE, OverLimit is FALSE even if Value exceeds the limit.
